entries.en: Added `/rewind` support for resuming a conversation from before `/clear` was run
entries.zh: 添加了`/rewind`支持，用于从运行`/clear`之前恢复对话

entries.en: Improved sandbox network permission dialog: hosts you allow with "Yes" are now remembered for the rest of the session instead of re-prompting on every connection
entries.zh: 改进沙盒网络权限对话框：选择「是」允许的主机在本次会话中会被记住，不再每次连接都重新询问

entries.en: Improved MCP server reliability: capability discovery (`tools/list`, `prompts/list`, `resources/list`) now retries transient network errors with short backoff
entries.zh: 改进 MCP 服务器可靠性：能力发现（`tools/list`、`prompts/list`、`resources/list`）遇到临时网络错误时，会短暂退避后重试

entries.en: Improved MCP OAuth: discovery and token requests now retry once after transient network errors, and headless environments skip the browser popup and go straight to the paste-the-URL prompt
entries.zh: 改进 MCP OAuth：发现和令牌请求遇到临时网络错误时会重试一次；无界面环境会跳过浏览器弹窗，直接进入“粘贴网址”提示

entries.en: Improved MCP error messages: HTTP 404 errors now show the URL and point to your MCP config
entries.zh: 改进 MCP 错误提示：HTTP 404 错误现在会显示网址，并指向你的 MCP 配置

entries.en: Improved vim mode prompt-history search (NORMAL `/`) to hint how to reach slash commands
entries.zh: 改进 vim 模式下的提示历史搜索（NORMAL 模式下按 `/`）：会提示如何进入斜杠命令

entries.en: Reduced CPU usage during streaming responses by ~37% by coalescing text updates to 100ms
entries.zh: 通过把文本更新合并为每 100 毫秒一次，流式输出时 CPU 占用降低约 37%

entries.en: Reduced long-session memory growth from terminal output cache
entries.zh: 通过限制终端输出缓存，减缓长会话中的内存增长

entries.en: Fixed scroll position jumping to the bottom while reading earlier output during a streaming response
entries.zh: 修复了在流响应期间读取较早输出时滚动位置跳到底部的问题

entries.en: Fixed background agents resurrecting after being stopped — stopping an agent from the tasks panel is now permanent
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理在被停止后复活的问题 - 从任务面板停止代理现在是永久性的

entries.en: Fixed `/voice` showing a generic "not available" message when disabled by an organization's policy — it now explains the restriction
entries.zh: 修复了`/voice`在被组织策略禁用时显示通用“不可用”消息的问题 - 现在它解释了该限制

entries.en: Fixed `/login` URL opening truncated in Windows Terminal when it wraps across lines
entries.zh: 修复了`/login` URL 打开在 Windows 终端中换行时被截断的问题

entries.en: Fixed Cmd+click on links in fullscreen mode for Ghostty over ssh/tmux
entries.zh: 修复了通过 ssh/tmux 在全屏模式下使用 Cmd+单击 Ghostty 链接的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` sending builtin slash commands like `/usage` to background sessions as prompt text instead of showing a hint
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Agents”将内置斜杠命令（例如`/usage`）作为提示文本发送到后台会话而不是显示提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` job rows showing full filesystem paths for pasted images instead of the `[Image #N]` placeholder
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Agents”作业行显示粘贴图像的完整文件系统路径，而不是`[Image #N]`占位符

entries.en: Fixed hooks with comma-separated matchers (e.g. `"Bash,PowerShell"`) silently never firing
entries.zh: 修复了带有逗号分隔匹配器的钩子（例如`“Bash，PowerShell”`）默默地从不触发

entries.en: Fixed `/permissions` Recently-denied tab: approving a denial now persists on close instead of being silently discarded
entries.zh: 修复了`/permissions`最近被拒绝的选项卡：批准拒绝现在在关闭时持续存在，而不是被默默丢弃

entries.en: Fixed the agent panel jumping by one row when scrolling the roster past the overflow cap
entries.zh: 修复智能体列表超出溢出上限滚动时，智能体面板跳动一行的问题

entries.en: Fixed the welcome splash art overflowing the default 80×24 macOS Terminal window
entries.zh: 修复欢迎启动画面的艺术图在默认 80×24 的 macOS 终端窗口中溢出的问题

entries.en: Fixed managed settings: `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` now takes effect when set via MDM or file policy, and the fetch sends `Cache-Control: no-cache` to prevent proxies from serving stale responses
entries.zh: 修复了托管设置：`forceRemoteSettingsRefresh`现在在通过 MDM 或文件策略设置时生效，并且获取会发送`Cache-Control: no-cache`以防止代理提供过时的响应
